        "The full three-file owned diff changes _rowMap to top-level rows, adds recursive visible rowCount/rowAt/indexOf, routes cell/parent/container queries through rowAt, and replaces splice-based expansion with open-state/count notifications. TreeDataRow rowCount counts visible descendants regardless of the row's own open flag; its parent determines exposure.",
        "The non-negative rowAt parameter is a documented precondition, not new native Array.at negative-index normalization. Owned LiveViewDataAdapter overrides rowCount/rowAt because its custom LiveViewRowMap is lazy. Custom at first checks #rows.at(index), then computes fetch offsets from the original index; a cached negative hit does not establish safe normalized negative misses.",
        "A bounded static issue exists in TreeDataRow.indexOf: after an open child does not contain the target, rowIndex + childRow.rowCount has no assignment. For children A(open, childG) and B, the static trace returns index1 for B while rowAt(2) locates B. The same unused addition remains at accepted line510. This is a direct-row API case, not an executed failure or a demonstrated production caller.",
        "Accepted TreeDataAdapter later uses a flat cache for count/rowAt/indexOf, so its indexOf does not recurse through the defective row-local method. Later cache filling, sparse-child counting, ensureChildren and current async Panorama loading are distinct phases and not attributed to the owned commit.",
        "All changed test hunks and complete affected empty/one-row/branching tasks are read. Twenty-three newly added assertions omit messages. They directly assert visible and row-local lookups, closed-child index-1, following top-level row shifts, count deltas and invalidation. The single-child branch does not cover a later row-local sibling after an open child subtree.",
        "Existing lookup, toggle-notification and branching-test lessons cover the broad contracts and are reused. The owned comments add non-negative index and inverse lookup results; optional child access is a future-oriented choice, not evidence that null children already occurred. Numeric offset loops, early returns and grouped count/notification steps have scoped roles, not a blanket loop-style rule.",
        "Bug1995652 full current0–3/end is retained once for both family commits. Its statement that only the flat address book used the adapter was historical, not an accepted current caller census.",

Reviewer caching/native-index fast-path proposals are deferred/rebutted, not adopted by approval. Author explains custom at and says flat Panorama did not yet need indexOf override; this is a historical claim, not a universal Array.at equivalence.",
